_what: Documents as rows (src/document-properties.mjs): a folder of the person's text documents read as a list's rows, each with its own properties (written in the document itself, as frontmatter), what the file is (name, folder, times, size, links, backlinks, tags) and formulas worked out from both. A list names the folder with row_sources [{ source: <source>, of: <folder> }]; a saved view names a value by its namespace and key (note.status, file.mtime, formula.late), the namespaces being src/lists.json source_namespaces.documents. The kinds of property, the file facts, the link and tag syntaxes and every bound are rows here; the code names none of them.
_source: The row source name a list uses for a folder of documents (src/lists.mjs withRowSources).
_sidecar_name: The one small file, at the top of the folder a list reads, that says each property's kind and the folder's formulas: { types: { <property>: <field kind> }, formulas: { <name>: <formula-engine binding> } }. Without it every property is text and there are no formulas.
_staging_suffix: A changed document's new bytes are first kept under <name><staging_suffix> and then given the document's name only if the document still is what was read (the Namespace's expected_identity), so a change made meanwhile is never overwritten. The staging name is removed in the same step.
_property_kinds: The list field kinds (src/lists.json field_kinds) a property may have. Computed and rule kinds are not properties: a formula is one of the folder's formulas.
_tag_keys: Property keys read as the document's tags and aliases, compared without case (Obsidian's tags/aliases convention).
_file_facts: The file.* values of every document: key is the name a view uses (file.<key>), kind its list field kind, from the fact it is read from (a Namespace listing column, a part of its name, or what its words link to).
_links: How a document's words link to another document: a regular expression whose first group is the target, resolved by name (a document's name without its folder or extension, as [[Weekly review]]) or by path (a name starting with / or relative to the document's folder, as [notes](../plan.md)). Web addresses (with a scheme) are not documents and are left out. embed says whether it is shown inside the document (file.embeds) rather than linked (file.links).
_inline_tag: A tag written in the words (#project/alpha); its first group is the tag. Tags are kept without their #.
_metadata_index: The persistent index of parsed documents by content identity (src/document-meta-index.mjs): entry_prefix + identity holds one document's parsed properties, links, tags and aliases; identities are listed in chunks of `chunk` under order_prefix + n in the order first kept; state_key holds { head, tail }. Past `kept` documents the oldest chunk is forgotten whole.
_limits: write_attempts: how many times a property change is made again on a document that changed meanwhile (each time on what it now says, so the other change is kept). documents_per_read: the documents one read of a folder looks at (backlinks are worked out among them; past it the read says complete: false). bytes_per_document: the most of a document read for its properties and links. parsed_kept: how many documents' parsed properties this isolate keeps, by content identity (a document's bytes never change under one identity, so nothing kept is ever stale). plain_file_rows: the most rows one export or import of a list moves.

plain_files._what: A list as plain files (src/list-plain-files.mjs): one document per row (<row id>.<row_extension>, its values as frontmatter and its first long-text field as the words), the list's field kinds in the folder's sidecar (sidecar_name above, with the list's own id, label and title field), and its links as one id-keyed graph (links_name: { nodes: { <row id>: { list } }, edges: { <edge id>: { from, field, to } } }). Links live only in the graph, never in a row's frontmatter, so they have one home; an edge whose end is missing is dropped on import.
